The Hub card's 2026-08 phone rows are of a sibling build, not of these bytes.
quantization: static range quantization for the Qualcomm HTP (litert-torch's experimental npu_export at 8379afb with the valid_mask fix of PR #1178, which upstream main carries since d49f1ba6; its gemma3-270m Qualcomm SM8850 preset; stages 1-3, no ahead-of-time step): int8 weights (the preset's recipe dynamic_wi8_afp32) and 16-bit integer activations at the ranges of 10 calibration prompts (the first 10 of npu_export's sample calibration prompts) with up to 32 decode steps each; the 15 calibration ranges of the rotary-position graphs raised to 1,023.96875 before stage 3 (in the file, 11 int16 tensors at a scale of exactly 1/32: every position of the 896-token cache exact); one prefill signature of 128 tokens and decode, with a fixed 896-token KV cache; the embedding lookup (tf_lite_embedder) and the rotary, mask and cache-update graphs (tf_lite_aux) in sections of their own
